svg.title: The teaching garden, March, 08.20
svg.desc: A campus garden with forty metre-square beds, a greenhouse, a compost bay built from pallets, a water butt and a shed with two padlocks.

g.text: Twelve things to find. Four exist for teaching. Four exist for food.
the campus kitchen, four days of salad
94 kg last year, across forty beds
a student with one bed, one semester
one metre, so you can reach the middle
a tray of seedlings, labelled by hand
crates by a gate, going the wrong way
the head chef, who put it on a board
the School, which never specified food
